kourindou_tagline: Everything that drifted in from the outside world
list_empty_hint: Kourindou is waiting for its first arrival.
load_error: Could not load. Try again shortly.
upload_field_title_hint: As the work spells it, usually Japanese
upload_cover_hint: JPEG / PNG / WebP / AVIF, up to 5MB
upload_license_required: Required. This is the most important field on the site.
upload_license_why: Permission to redistribute varies by circle. Stating it accurately tells downloaders the risk and lets rights holders reach you. Misstating it can get the resource delisted and lower your trust level.
upload_license_allowed_desc: The circle states redistribution is allowed, in the readme, on their page, or in their terms
upload_license_unspecified_desc: You found nothing stating anything either way — pick this when unsure
upload_license_out_of_print_desc: No longer published and no official way to buy it
upload_license_licensed_desc: You have the rights holder’s permission, or the work is openly licensed
upload_license_note_hint: Optional. What you based that on — a link to the circle’s page, for instance.
upload_mirror_none: At least one mirror is required
upload_review_hint: Check it over and submit. Uploads from new accounts go to the review queue first.
upload_ok_pending_desc: It goes public once approved. After a few approvals your uploads publish immediately.
upload_failed: Submission failed — check and try again
dash_note_hint: Optional, recorded in the audit log
dash_strike_warning: Copyright or illegal records a strike against the uploader and resets their trust to zero.
admin_staff_only_hint: By default this lists current staff only. Someone you are about to promote is still a regular user — find them with the search above.
admin_reason_required: A reason is required — it goes into the audit log
admin_self_hint: This is you. An admin cannot demote themselves — that could lock everyone out.
admin_admin_immutable: Admin status can only be changed with the grant-role script on the server; there is no HTTP path for it.
admin_trash_hint: Resources moved to trash live here. They are invisible on public pages.
admin_purge_warning: Permanent deletion cannot be undone: versions, download links, ratings and comments all go with it. The audit record is kept so you can still say what was removed and why.
admin_soft_delete_hint: Takes it off public pages and can be undone. Use this first when a takedown request comes in.
admin_registration_hint: When off, new visitors cannot sign up. Existing accounts are unaffected.
admin_auto_publish_hint: Contributors with this many approved resources and no strikes skip the queue. Setting it to 0 means nobody is reviewed.
admin_takedown_hint: Shown publicly so rights holders can request a takedown.
err_generic: That didn't go through. Please try again in a moment.
err_rate_limited: You're posting too quickly. Wait a moment and try again.
err_link_not_allowed: New accounts cannot post external links yet. This lifts once your account is 3 days old, or one of your uploads is approved.
err_mention_limit_exceeded: You can mention at most 10 people in one post.
err_validation_failed: That doesn't look right. Please check it and try again.
err_forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
err_not_found: That no longer exists, or has been removed.
admin_link_trust_hint: How many approved uploads before a user may post external links (a 3-day-old account also qualifies). Separate from the auto-publish threshold on purpose: posts can be deleted, so links open first and tighten if abused; distribution cannot be recalled, so uploads are reviewed first. 0 means no limit.
admin_reset_strikes_hint: Strikes only ever go up, and they veto external links and auto-publish before the threshold is even checked — setting the threshold to 0 does not help. A wrong call can only be undone here, and it is written to the audit log.
